items.source: Marks a property to be populated with the result of a scripted field retrieved from an Elasticsearch response.
items.translation: 将属性标记为需要填充从 Elasticsearch 响应中检索的脚本字段的结果。

items.source: (Optional) The name of the scripted field.

(Optional) The name of the scripted field. Defaults to
the field name.
items.translation: （可选）脚本字段的名称。默认为字段名。
